title: See where end-to-end tests are thin
statement: As a product manager, I can list where our end-to-end tests are thin, so we can see it when deciding what to test next.
overview: Proposed addition, as the first of the QA tools. These are measures to read, not work to clear: an app may be fine with few end-to-end tests, or none.

acceptance_criteria.statement: It lists criteria whose end-to-end tests are all positive.
It lists stories and criteria with no end-to-end test.
It lists catalog entries that verify no criterion.
It lists entries whose code or criterion link is stale.
Each list is grouped by feature, comes with `--json`, fails nothing, and says nothing about which item matters most.
